title: Audit log silently drops events on DB failure and channel overflow
description: audit.rs: two silent drop paths. (1) flush_buffer() lines 201-207: pool.begin() failure clears buffer without retry or error. (2) log() line 125: try_send() on full channel (1000-slot) discards events and only logs a warning. Security audit events (auth attempts, GC runs, admin access) are silently lost during DB unavailability or sustained load — exactly when they matter most. False sense of completeness. Fix: (1) do not clear buffer on tx failure; retry or persist to stderr. (2) document channel overflow as a known gap, add a metric counter.
design: Decision: drop-and-count. Channel full: drop event, increment audit_events_dropped_total counter (Prometheus). DB failure: log error at ERROR level, clear buffer, increment counter. Do not block callers, do not spill to stderr. Rationale: blocking risks stalling auth hot path; the metric makes drops visible to operators without adding a fallback sink.
